In the eleventh month, on the jisi day, an edict ordered the Hanlin National History Office, the Academy of Gathered Worthies, and the Kui Zhang Academy to assemble and deliberate on the late emperor's temple name, spirit tablet, elevation of Wuzong's empress to joint worship, and changing the era name.
升祔武宗皇后 means elevating Wuzong's empress to joint temple worship; Empress Wuzong wrongly treats 武宗 as her personal name.
